basis: V2 non-AIME discovery measurements only; no AIME or answers used. Independent numerical implementation, not inherited PACE scores.
structural_gate: Exact shapes, masks, period-only configuration difference, zero nonfinite, exact counters and preserve tail semantics; unchanged prefill bitwise.

floating_gate.reason: Engineering bound on normalized output/delta/state drift, including BF16 final rounding and rare original-codec boundary changes. Not a theorem or bit-equivalence claim.

packed_gate: Every unequal integer code must be reproduced by the unchanged encoder and explained by adjacent FP16 scale / integer zero / RNE code boundary; unexplained count must be zero. All mismatch counts and first divergence retained.
holdout: Additional257-decode weak-decay stress; full38cases plus stress; second fresh process. No tolerance changes after holdout.
formal_gate: All assigned GPU non-AIME full-model smoke, same-code source admission and original protocol verification; formal starts only after complete gate.
